title: Tuek Som Garage: Behind the scenes of driving an internal Corporate Startup Incubator
image1Description: Atmosphere of the competition and Production system in the Tuek Som Garage project

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: Tuek Som Garage is a Startup incubation project within the group of companies that gives employees the chance to send ideas to solve business problems and create new products. The goal is to select the best ideas from employees nationwide to develop into real products. My intent in this project was to create a platform (both physical and online) so that employees with ideas and executives could interact most effectively, amidst an overwhelming response from employees who sent in more than 130 projects.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I served as a main STAFF in the Production and Infrastructure part of the project, from the selection of the final 12 teams to the intensive training (Bootcamp) on various topics such as making an MVP, Marketing, and Finance. My role was to control the light, color, and sound systems on stage to create an atmosphere that stimulates creativity. This included making public relations media for the project and, most importantly, setting up a high-quality Live Streaming system so that employees in provincial branches could watch and learn from speakers at the same time as people in the central office.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The main challenge was managing activities that lasted a long time and had complex details, from managing the schedules of many speakers to preparing the venue for brainstorming for all 12 teams at the same time. Additionally, there was a challenge in communicating with a large number of employees so they could see the continuous progress of the project, and controlling the online system standards to prevent errors during the important Pitching moments, which are the deciding seconds for the contestants.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: The project was highly successful in creating a Startup culture within the organization. We were able to select the ideas with the highest potential to successfully enter the real product development process. This activity taught me the process of creating a new Business Unit from zero (Zero to One) through a Startup perspective. I also developed Organizer management skills, coordinating with high-level executives and many people, which is an important foundation for strategic project management in the future.
